description: A big, deep, rumbly cartoon dragon voice performed by an adult male voice actor speaking Polish: slow, grumbly and silly, comically greedy for food, suspicious hmmm sounds, warm and funny, never menacing.
text: Hmmm… Owieczki… Moje! Owca, która nie beczy? Hmmm… Mniam, mniam… Oj. Ojojoj… Brzuch! Pić! Gorąco! Pić! Ojej, ale mi niedobrze.
